scope.purpose: Notify briefly about something the user just did or that just happened, without blocking the page.
useCases: Upload failed with a Retry action.
Item deleted with an Undo action.
exclusions: Rich content (images, forms) in a toast.
A keyboard shortcut to jump to the region: later on demand.
alternatives: Dialog for a message that must be answered.

examples.preview: dist/previews/toast.html (npm run build && npm run build:preview toast)

decisionsTaken: One compound contract (decision of 2026-10-31): the root is the region (placement, max, label); the child item is one toast. The application owns the list and removes a toast when it emits dismiss; the Svelte adapter may add a small helper to manage the list (implementation).
Toast surface neutral (color.surface.overlay, shadow.overlay, elevation border, radius.overlay) with the status icon in color: the words carry the message.
Width size.overlay.panel (new semantic role shared with Popover and Menu, 360 px); region at space.layout.sm from the viewport edges; default placement bottom-end; max 3 visible.
Duration 5 s; the countdown pauses on hover, on focus inside and when the document is hidden.
A toast with an action never dismisses itself (WCAG 2.2.1), and its action must exist elsewhere (open question 4).
Announcements: polite except danger (assertive); appearing never moves focus.
Open question 4 resolved (user, 2026-11-03: "Oui"): a toast with an action never dismisses itself, and its action also exists elsewhere in the interface.
Toast leaving is the one JavaScript-driven transition of the wave: overlay motion stays CSS only (decisions.md), but a toast is removed from the DOM by the application, not hidden.
Toast round 2 (user, 2026-11-03): appearance neutral|intense, automatic layout, 8 s with an action, danger persistent by default, closable; intense accent actions take the intent family.
Toast actions are secondary only (user, 2026-11-03): ghost or outline, neutral or danger, never accent; a snippet cannot enforce it, the rule is documented (decisions.md, snippet slots).
nextAction: Wave 3 Figma parity gate (grouped), second round after the user review of 2026-11-04: review the changes; then documentation (ggb-docs).
implementationNotes: Exports ToastRegion (the region, root of the contract) and Toast (the item child).

The region is a div with role region (not a section: an application's section styles moved it) shown as a manual popover in the top layer; it raises itself again whenever another overlay enters the top layer after it (a capture listener on toggle events).

Platform limit: a modal dialog makes everything outside it inert, top layer included. A toast sent while a modal dialog is open is seen above the dialog but cannot be pressed, focused or announced until the dialog closes (checked in toast.spec.ts). The contract says the region stays above open dialogs; visually it does.
The countdown is paused while the pointer is over the region, while focus is inside it, while the document is hidden and while the toast is queued (data-queued set by the region beyond max).

Leaving uses a Svelte out transition (global) reading the motion tokens from CSS: the application removes the toast from the list, so a CSS exit transition has nothing to run on; under reduced motion it only fades. Entering uses @starting-style.

pendingChanges.change: User feedback at the wave 3 implementation review (2026-11-03, session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c543GZBnpgBmqmSNfDLB): centered layout, automatic single or multi line (actions under the description), appearance neutral or intense (named by the user), a toast with an action fades after 8 s by default, danger stays by default, closable prop; sending a toast from a modal dialog documented as not supported ("ce n'est pas une bonne pratique d'ouvrir une toast depuis une dialog"). To be re-presented at the wave 3 implementation gate.

User at the implementation review round 2: "Jamais de bouton en accent, c'est des actions secondaires […] des btn en ghost, border et à la limite danger, pas plus de complexité" — the action is a ghost or outline Button, neutral or danger; the intense redirection of accent buttons is removed.

User at the implementation review round 3: "les boutons ne suivent pas l'intent non plus en mode intense". In appearance intense, buttons of intent accent or neutral (action and dismiss) take the action family of the toast's intent, as in an Alert; danger keeps its own.
